comparison.objective: Grind peppercorns while holding a mortar still; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained bimanual stabilization and circular rubbing versus hex-key manipulation, fine collar adjustment, bounded locking torque, and cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Five rounds of effective grinding and tool return versus two acceptable carriage stops. Candidate rebound/overload/drift limits are not fully quantified.
comparison.reason: Shared counterholding does not make grinding equivalent to commissioning an adjustable mechanism.
